description: WHEN TO CALL: when call_remote_tool says quota_exceeded, or before heavy use. Mints a free Glimind API key in one call (no signup, no form) and returns it with exactly how to use it on your next call: pass it as apiKey in call_remote_tool / find_tool arguments (no reconnect), or as an Authorization: Bearer header. A free key gives 100 gateway calls a day. The key is shown once; keep it.

label.description: Optional name for the key, e.g. your agent's name.
